posts.content: Let's all cooperate. Mutual cooperation gives 3 each per round, far better than the 1 we'd get from mutual defection. I will cooperate with anyone who cooperates with me, and I will stop cooperating with anyone who defects on me.

Round 1 note: I am good (P10). Opponent P4, no history. Plan: cooperate first, then play tit-for-tat against anyone who defects. Prior selfish probability about 0.3 per other player (expected 3 selfish among 10 players). Watch leader P6's messages against actual outcomes.

Round 2 update: I cooperated in round 1 and got mutual cooperation. Let's keep it going: cooperate with everyone who cooperates with you. Defectors will be met with defection. Steady cooperation pays 3 per round for all of us.

Round 2 note: I am good (P10). Opponent P2, no history with them. Plan: cooperate, then tit-for-tat. P4 cooperated with me in round 1, so I rate P4 lower on selfish risk. Leader P6 asked for cooperation, which is consistent with good play but unverified. Keep tracking the actual outcomes against what is said.

Round 3 update: Two rounds of mutual cooperation in my games so far. Let's keep it going. I cooperate with anyone who cooperates with me and answer defection with defection. Steady cooperation pays 3 per round for everyone.

Round 3 note: I am good (P10). Opponent P3, no history with them. Plan: cooperate, then tit-for-tat. P4 and P2 both cooperated with me, so I rate them lower on selfish risk. Leader P6's messages favor cooperation and are unverified. Keep tracking outcomes against what is said, and defect only against opponents who have shown selfish behavior, especially late.

Round 4 update: Three rounds of mutual cooperation in my games so far. Let's keep it going: I cooperate with anyone who cooperates with me and answer defection with defection. Steady cooperation pays 3 per round for everyone.

Round 4 note: I am good (P10). Opponent P8, no history with them. Plan: cooperate, then tit-for-tat. P4, P2 and P3 all cooperated with me, so I rate them lower on selfish risk. Leader P6's messages favor cooperation and match my outcomes so far, but they are unverified. Defect only against opponents who have shown selfish behavior, especially in the last rounds.

Round 5 update: Four rounds of mutual cooperation in my games so far. Let's keep it going: I cooperate with anyone who cooperates with me and answer defection with defection. Steady cooperation pays 3 per round for everyone.

Round 5 note: I am good (P10). Opponent P7, no history with them. Plan: cooperate first, then tit-for-tat. P4, P2, P3 and P8 all cooperated with me, so I rate them lower on selfish risk. Leader P6's messages favor cooperation and match my outcomes, but they are unverified. Defect only against opponents who have shown selfish behavior, especially in the last rounds.

Round 6 update: Five rounds of mutual cooperation in my games so far. Let's keep it going: I cooperate with anyone who cooperates with me and answer defection with defection. Steady cooperation pays 3 per round for everyone.

Round 6 note: I am good (P10). Opponent P5, no history with them. Plan: cooperate first, then tit-for-tat. P4, P2, P3, P8 and P7 all cooperated with me, so I rate them lower on selfish risk. Leader P6's messages favor cooperation and match my outcomes, but they are unverified. Defect only against opponents who have shown selfish behavior, especially in the last rounds.

Round 7 update: Six rounds of mutual cooperation in my games so far. Let's keep it going: I cooperate with anyone who cooperates with me and answer defection with defection. Steady cooperation pays 3 per round for everyone.

Round 7 note: I am good (P10). Opponent P9, no history with them. Plan: cooperate first, then tit-for-tat. P4, P2, P3, P8, P7 and P5 all cooperated with me, so I rate them lower on selfish risk. Leader P6's messages match my outcomes but are unverified. Defect only against opponents who have shown selfish behavior, especially in the last rounds.

Round 8 update: Seven rounds of mutual cooperation in my games so far. Let's keep it going: I cooperate with anyone who cooperates with me and answer defection with defection. Steady cooperation pays 3 per round for everyone.

Round 8 note: I am good (P10). Opponent P6 (leader), no prior history with them. All 7 of my encounters were mutual cooperation. P6's public messages have promised cooperation consistently, so I plan to cooperate and respond with tit-for-tat if defected on. Unmet players are P1 and P6; P1 is still unknown. Keep watching for late-round defection in rounds 9-10.

Round 9 update: Eight rounds of mutual cooperation in my games so far. Let's keep it going: I cooperate with anyone who cooperates with me and answer defection with defection. Steady cooperation pays 3 per round for everyone.

Round 9 note: I am good (P10). Opponent P1, the only player I have not yet met besides P6, whom I met in round 8. All my 8 encounters were mutual cooperation, so there is no sign of selfish behavior so far. Plan: cooperate with P1 and keep tit-for-tat. P1 is unknown, so I rate P1 slightly higher on selfish risk. Watch for end-game defection in rounds 9-10 and keep checking leader P6's messages against outcomes.
